chunks: Why then do they turn away from the admonition
ai.seo_question: Why did the disbelievers turn away from the Quranic admonition?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Muddaththir, this verse underscores the psychological state of the Quraysh, who actively turned away from the Prophet's warning despite its clarity. Shia exegetes often link this 'turning away' to the concept of *al-Israf* (excessive pride) and the hardening of the heart, illustrating how deliberate neglect of divine reminders leads to spiritual blindness.
